text:
oliver: Heads-up — FinMark just asked for an urgent remediation timeline and evidence bundle. They found references to CVE-2026-12345 in our dependency graph (transitive via lib-fastseq) and want: SBOM entry, confirmation of fix, and a SOC2-friendly remediation statement by EOD their timezone. Can someone triage impact/ETA?

maria: On it. Quick summary from initial scan: CVE-2026-12345 affects lib-fastseq < 2.1.4. It's a deserialization issue with remote payloads. In our product it's pulled transitively by runtime-shared (only used by hosted inference pipeline). Exploitation requires attacker-supplied model bundle ingestion or access to the model upload path. Severity: CVSS 7.5 (High). Classifying as P2 for customer-facing remediation with targeted mitigations now.

oliver: Thanks — customer wants concrete dates, proof artifacts, and whether KMS rotation or SOC2 evidence needed.

maria: Plan: 1) Immediate mitigation: block unauth model uploads from untrusted sources + add validation on ingestion (WAF rule + input validation). 2) Patch: upgrade lib-fastseq to 2.1.4 and backport to our runtime-shared v1.8.x branch. 3) Deployment: canary to dedicated pool, run fuzz/regression tests, rollback plan in place. 4) Evidence: SBOM diff + PR link + test logs + KMS/audit logs clarification. ETA: patch PR within 4h, canary deploy within 24h, full rollout 72h after successful canary. Evidence bundle (SBOM + remediation statement) within 48h. Internal ticket S-2234 for tracking.

devon: I can cut the branch now. Repro + fix should be straightforward — will open PR and attach unit/regression runs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime-shared/pull/4823 (draft). I'll aim to have it ready for review in ~3.5h.

jess: Question on KMS: customer asked if key rotation is necessary or if their encrypted artifacts were exposed. We need a short position and logs to show no key compromise. Also they asked for RBAC changes to limit model-upload roles — can we show the change?

maria: KMS impact: based on our access logs there were no unusual operations for the model-upload key. We don't plan a rotation as part of immediate remediation (rotation would be noisy and not required unless evidence of compromise). We'll provide KMS access logs (filtered) and a signed statement. RBAC: plan to restrict model upload to a new role upload_model+approve_by_ops for hosted accounts and add a guardrail in the console. Devon — can you add a short ACL tweak in the canary?

devon: Yep — adding ACL change in the same PR (config + migration). Canary will include the RBAC tweak.

sec-bot: Audit export ready: https://internal-artifacts.redwood/audit-exports/S-2234/audit-2026-03-20.zip (contains filtered auth logs, model-upload events, and KMS operation logs).

audit-bot: SBOM delta generated: https://internal-artifacts.redwood/sboms/S-2234/sbom-diff-1765432100.json

maria: For SOC2: we'll produce a concise remediation statement mapping the control (CC6/Change Management + SysOps) to the actions taken, include proof artifacts (PR, SBOM diff, audit logs), and a timeline of events+validation results. Draft will be in C-EXTERNAL format for customers.

oliver: Can we commit to the 48h evidence bundle? Customer legal is pushing that as part of their vendor review cutoff.

maria: Yes, 48h for bundle delivery (SBOM diff, remediation statement, PR link, canary logs). If tests fail we escalate with a mitigation note.

devon: PR is now in review (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime-shared/pull/4823). CI: unit tests green, regression fuzz running (ETA 45m). Added migration for ACL and a simple input sanitizer.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for runtime-shared:v1.8.7-canary-4823 at 1765432160 — target: dedicated-gpu-pool-3.

maria: Ops will monitor canary for 12 hours. If no anomalies, we'll roll to 30% traffic at 36h and full at 72h. Will document rollback steps (restore previous version, revoke new ACL migration if needed).

jess: For the SOC2 evidence, I'll prepare a short appendix describing why KMS rotation wasn't necessary and include the filtered KMS logs + HSM audit summary. Also will include a note on RBAC change and how it ties to least privilege.

oliver: Perfect. I'll update FinMark with the timeline and include links once the bundle is ready. Please flag if anything changes. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll post the final evidence bundle to the customer folder and ping legal for the C-EXTERNAL signoff before sending.

oliver: Thanks all. Keep me posted.

maria: quick follow-up — if the customer insists on key rotation as a condition, we can offer a scheduled rotation within 7 days with support assistance, but note it will cause short-term re-encryption work for historical artifacts.

oliver: I'll note that option.

maria: S-2234 updated with links + timeline. Closing thread for triage — reopen if anything critical pops.

oliver: Acknowledged, thanks everyone.
